# Mudkraft

> Slow craft studio shaping pots, kulhads, planters and diyas from river clay — handmade in Khurja, fired in a slow wood kiln.

Mudkraft is a small pottery studio working with a single family of Khurja potters. Every piece is thrown by hand from Ganges-tributary river clay, dried under sky, and fired at 920–1040 °C in a 48-hour wood kiln. Orders and workshop bookings are confirmed personally over WhatsApp.

## Pages

- [Home](/): The collection — Surahi Matka, Kulhad, Bottle & Jug, Handi, Chhoti Handi, Steam Dome — plus the story of the wheel.
- [Workshops & Soil Report](/workshops): Pottery workshops for schools, birthdays, private parties and corporate offsites, plus the full lab soil report of the river clay we use.
- [Benefits of Clay Water Pots](/journal/benefits-of-clay-water-pots): Guide to the health benefits of matka water, natural cooling, and how to season and clean a new earthen pot.
